name: Stability Ball Seated Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit near the front of the ball with both legs extended, heels planted and toes pointing up.
Keep your spine straight and place your hands lightly on your thighs for support.
Hinge slowly forward from your hips until you feel a clear, comfortable stretch along the backs of both thighs.
Hold the stretch steadily while breathing slowly, then sit back upright gently to release.
tips: Keep the ball steady beneath your hips and hinge from your pelvis rather than rounding your shoulders.
Soften your knees very slightly if locking them fully feels tight behind the joints.
